title: AUM value update can be sandwiched to extract value from the protocol
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** Low  ## Description  Protocol requires the off-chain bot to update AUM value so it can compute the share amount in deposited/withdrawal function and the attacker can use this to his advantage and perform the sandwich attack to extract value from the protocol. This is the POC:  1. Suppose the price of T1 token is 1 and protocol's `AUM` is $98K and `totalShare` is $98K. 2.
